bull.t: Material debt reduction / stronger balance sheet
bull.b: A markedly lower debt load and improved debt-to-equity (~0.39) materially increase financial flexibility, reduce interest burden, and support investment or shareholder returns over the medium term. This makes the company more resilient through offshore capex cycles and fundable for multi-year projects.

bull.t: Robust cash generation and FCF conversion
bull.b: Consistent, sizable operating cash flow and high free cash flow relative to earnings indicate strong cash conversion and earnings quality. This underpins durable capacity to fund capex, pay down debt, sustain dividends, and execute buybacks regardless of near-term revenue timing variability.

bull.t: Large Subsea backlog and technology adoption
bull.b: A deep, growing Subsea pipeline and high backlog coverage produce multi-quarter revenue visibility and support margin sustainability as recurring, large-scale contracts convert. Strong Subsea 2.0 adoption and larger average project sizes enhance competitive positioning and expected efficiency gains over coming years.

bear.b: Prior multi-year swings from losses to profitability show the business is cyclical and exposed to offshore capex swings. Even with current improvement, cyclicality can erode margins and cash generation if oilfield investment softens, making medium-term planning and stable returns more challenging.

bear.t: Surface Technologies segment timing and regional exposure
bear.b: A meaningful sequential drop in Surface revenue and EBITDA tied to project scheduling highlights dependence on uncertain regional project timing. Segment underperformance can weigh on consolidated revenue and creates execution risk if Middle East or other regional scheduling remains uneven over several quarters.

bear.t: Order timing lumpiness and unannounced large-project risk
bear.b: Reliance on a small number of large awards means revenue and margin recognition can be lumpy and sensitive to announcement/timing. This order-concentration risk complicates forecasting and can produce volatile quarterly results even if the long-term pipeline remains healthy.
